businessFlow.subject: Scheduled exports list now offers a Delete action (DELETE /admin/scheduled-exports/:id) that hard-removes a scheduled export so future runs stop
steps: verify the Delete button appears on the row
click Delete and confirm the row is removed (list shows 'No scheduled exports configured')

notes: DELETE /admin/scheduled-exports/:id removes the registry row; the worker only reads enabled rows, so future runs stop. No console errors from the flow.
